About the studio

Built by two photographers who got tired of stiff, over-posed wedding albums.

Avadh Digital started with one couple's wedding, shot on a borrowed lens, and a shared conviction: most wedding photography looks staged because it's directed too much. We slowed down. We started shooting the in-between moments — the nervous pacing before the pheras, the aunt crying during the vidaai — and let those stay in the final edit.

Today we're a five-person crew — two photographers, a cinematographer, an editor, and a producer who keeps the whole day on schedule — covering everything from the mehndi to the reception, across the city and destination weddings alike.

How a shoot runs

Every project moves through the same three stages.
Stage 01

Shoot

A pre-shoot call to lock mood, location, and shot list, then a full session on the day — studio or on-location.

Stage 02

Develop

Selects are culled within 48 hours. Color grading and retouching follow our in-house film-inspired look.

Stage 03

Deliver

Final gallery and edited film delivered via private online gallery, with prints available on request.
